surface.scope: Versioned measurements embedded between the existing Rehacer form and its selected project.

directionContract.thesis: Make versioned reconstruction measurements readable and actionable in Rehacer.
directionContract.ownWorld: Inherit the dark workbench palette, shared panels, fields, buttons and compact table.
directionContract.story: Configure a version, run references, inspect coverage and errors, open evidence, export and compare.
directionContract.firstViewport: Show scope, configuration and access to an active batch while inspecting history.
directionContract.form: Incumbent Operate extension using the established form and table grammar.

typography.title: 14px semibold
typography.body: Shared 14px body and inherited control/help steps

layout.configuration: Wrapping flex rows with version, references, method, round budget and primary action.
layout.mobile: Stack flexible controls at390px. Keep method and rounds together when space allows. Contain table overflow locally.
layout.status: Group measured/selected coverage, errors and the measured-only mean. Wrap long version labels.
layout.history: Keep the inspected result selected while exposing the active batch above configuration.

behavior.activeBatch: Identify the running version and provide its opening control while it occupies the evaluator.
behavior.evidence: Open the existing Rehacer project or download its retained JSON results.
behavior.comparison: Show paired measured coverage and explicit incompatible configuration fields.

verification.visualReview: The finish reviewer scored the active-batch access fix resolved.
